# Why probability boxes: out-of-sample comparison of ambiguity criteria (generated by experiments/run_ambiguity_summary.py)

Nine metro instances (22 customer zones, seed 0 of the BRL study), 20 training draws per n, criteria planned with the same local-search + set-partitioning heuristic, 20000 held-out days per instance. Means over the nine cities, sd over draws (city-averaged). Regret and tail are in percent of the cost of the best known plan for the test law.
